{{Quote|Crans, Portin - go get in the passageway. If I whistle, come out and kill everything that's not us.|[[Zothip]]|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Crans''' was one of the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] under the command of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Zothip]].

Crans, Zothip, and several other pirates including [[Portin]], [[Grinner]], and [[Control (individual)|Control]], infiltrated [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]]'s quarters on the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] capital of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. Crans didn't realize that they were being followed by the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] known as [[Karoly D'ulin]]. Once inside, Karoly killed Zothip. After Zothip's death, Control took over as the head of the Cavrilhu Pirates.
